displayDescription.description:
Description text to render below the #displayName. This may be a string reference to a
{@link Translation#key}

displaySearchPlaceholder.description:
Text to render in the Search input as the placeholder when this tool is selected. This may be a string reference
to a {@link Translation#key}

icon.description:
The icon (from https://fontawesome.com/v6/icons/) to use. Not all icons are supported out-of-the-box, so this may
also require an update to `GenAiUiQueryToolSelectorDropdown.scss` and `GenAiUiVariables.scss`
for some icons.

toolId.description:
The id of the {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Config} that this UI options is for. This field does not need to be set in
metadata, but it will be set in the result of {@link Genai.Agent.Config#uiMenuToolOptions}

toolName.description:
The name of the tool. This field does not need to be populated in the {@link Genai.Agent.Tool.Config} but will be
set in the result of {@link Genai.Agent.Config#uiMenuToolOptions}

featureFlags.description:
UI Features to modify (enable, disable, hide, etc.) if this option is selected. In most cases, the key will match
one of the fields on a config type, such as {@link Genai.App.ReadOnlyConfig} or GenAiUiConfig, but this is
not a requirement. For any new key, associated UI code will need to be written to properly handle the feature flag.

category.description: Groups the selected tools when GenAiUiConfig's allowMultipleToolSelection is set to true.

title: Configuration for how a tool should be shown in the UI dropdown.
name: Genai.Agent.Tool.Config.UiOptions
